title: A coercive space-time variational approach to fractional diffusion problems
summary: We consider a fractional diffusion problem with temporal nonlocality acting on the diffusive flux. A coercive space--time variational formulation in Bochner-valued fractional Sobolev spaces is derived and the existence, uniqueness, and regularity of solutions are established. We further develop a conforming tensor-product Galerkin discretization and prove quasi-optimal error estimates in the anisotropic energy norm and improved convergence rates in weaker norms using duality arguments.
